hero.title: Shape the future of real estate with us.
hero.description: Since 2011, Aqar One has grown into one of Jeddah's most trusted real estate groups — licensed across six services by the Real Estate General Authority and rated Class "A" across Saudi Arabia.

values.title: A licensed, accredited platform for serious careers.

items.title: Accredited credibility
items.description: Classified by the Real Estate General Authority across Ejar, brokerage, marketing, Mullak, facility management, and Sakani financing guidance — and accredited as a judicial sale agent by the Ministry of Justice.

items.title: Real ownership
items.description: We are building departments, not just filling seats. Leaders here design structures, set policies, and own outcomes end to end — with direct access to decision-makers.

items.title: Sustainable growth
items.description: Fifteen years of steady growth in Jeddah's market. Your work compounds: measurable KPIs, weekly reviews, and continuous improvement are how we operate.

steps.title: Apply online
steps.description: Submit your CV through the role page. We confirm receipt within one business day.

steps.title: Screening call
steps.description: A 20–30 minute call with HR to align on experience, expectations, and fit.

steps.title: Interviews
steps.description: On-site interviews with leadership, including a practical case relevant to the role.

steps.title: Offer & onboarding
steps.description: A written offer, then a structured onboarding plan for your first 90 days.

items.question: How do I apply?
items.answer: Open the role page and submit the application form with your CV (PDF preferred). You can also email hr@aqar1.com with the role code in the subject line.

items.question: How long does the hiring process take?
items.answer: Typically two to three weeks from application to offer: screening call within a few days, then on-site interviews, then a written offer.

items.question: Are roles on-site or remote?
items.answer: Our roles are on-site at our Jeddah offices (Al-Safa or Obhur Al-Shamaliyah), unless the role page states otherwise.

items.question: Can I apply if no role matches my profile?
items.answer: Yes — send your CV to hr@aqar1.com with a short note on where you would add value. We keep strong profiles on file and reach out when a matching role opens.

cta.title: Don't see your role?
cta.description: We're always looking for exceptional people. Send your CV and tell us where you'd fit.
